# Airlie Marketing
> Charlottesville-based done-for-you marketing for home-services businesses (plumbers, HVAC, electricians). We handle Google Business Profile, reviews, social, Nextdoor, and AI & search visibility so local trades get found and get called.

- Business: Airlie Marketing
- Founder: Micah Scott
- Serving: Charlottesville & Albemarle County, Virginia
- Website: https://airliemarketing.com
- Phone / text: (434) 218-0755
- Email: micah@airliemarketing.com

## Plans
- Get Found — $275/month: Local SEO (Google Business Profile management + consistent listings), review responses, 4 posts/month, branded graphics.
- Grow — $450/month (most popular): adds weekly Google posts, active review generation, Nextdoor, 8 posts/month, monthly email, monthly report.
- Pro — $750/month: adds AI & search visibility, 12 posts/month, 2 emails/month, seasonal campaign, video scripts, quarterly strategy call.

Founding client pricing: these rates are locked in for 12 months for founding clients, in exchange for an honest review and permission to share results as a case study.

## One-time add-ons
- One-page website build — $950 (or $650 with any monthly plan; billed half up front, half at launch)
- Website refresh (words, design, and layout) — $450–$650
- Google review-generation setup — $500

## Why Airlie
Local and family-run. Month-to-month, no long contracts. You approve everything. About 10–15 minutes a month from the client.

## Common questions
Q: Do I have to sign a long contract?
A: No — a 3-month start, then month-to-month, cancel anytime.
Q: What does it cost?
A: Plans start at $275/month; most choose the $450 Grow plan.
